about: NOT INSTALLED: removed from the mac base image on 2026-11-10 after losing the benchmark to macos-mcp; reinstall it before re-running. Was: steipete/Peekaboo 4.9.8: Peekaboo.app (login LaunchAgent) holds the TCC grants as Bridge host; `peekaboo mcp` over SSH attaches to its bridge.sock
ready: for i in $(seq 12); do ~/.local/share/peekaboo/peekaboo permissions status --bridge-socket "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Peekaboo/bridge.sock" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'Source: Peekaboo Bridge' && exit 0; sleep 3; done; exit 1
